implementation_scope: multi-seed, reduced-scale DMC mechanism study; not an exact large-scale reproduction of the original ImageNet benchmarks

interpretation_contract.anti_collapse_evidence: Use raw feature spread and effective rank together; effective rank alone is scale invariant and cannot detect near-zero representations.
interpretation_contract.representation_utility: Use held-out per-variable state-probe R2 alongside collapse diagnostics; non-collapse alone does not prove useful representation learning.
interpretation_contract.training_diagnostics: Record loss and representation spread/rank at early, middle, and final epochs for encoder and loss-space heads.

architecture_contract.simsiam: 3-layer BatchNorm projector with affine-free output BatchNorm; 2-layer BatchNorm predictor; stop-gradient cosine loss
architecture_contract.byol: online and EMA target networks with BatchNorm MLP heads and cosine loss
architecture_contract.barlow_twins: 3-layer BatchNorm projector and cross-correlation redundancy-reduction loss
architecture_contract.backbone: shared lightweight convolutional encoder rather than the original large-scale benchmark backbone

config.optimizer: Adam for all methods in this reduced-scale DMC study

barlow_twins.normalization_note: Batch feature standardization is performed in the loss; this matches the objective but is not code-identical to the official output BatchNorm implementation.

provenance.purpose: expanded five-seed reduced-scale DMC mechanism study
provenance.interpretation: descriptive mechanism comparison; not an exact ImageNet-scale reproduction or universal method ranking
